timing_scope: CPU single Torch thread, paired same poses and same fixed actor. Scan→observation (near+native far channels only)→projected action, no physics, not a realtime guarantee. 32 input width is a timing proxy using unchanged length-agnostic convolution/pooling, not policy evaluation.
floor_scope: First returns whose world hit z<=0.05 m are marked unknown in the far reducer. No recast or promotion to free; fixed ray denominator.
localization_scope: Peak is true bin score >=0.05 above both neighbors; highest-score blind bin projects within wall span +/-1.45 m; ties select smallest heading angle magnitude. Occupancy is scored by 1-occ; goal/velocity alignment are non-geometric controls.
quantile_scope: Candidate-only, normalized range of observed far hits and no-hit free rays (8m), dropped/occluded rays excluded.

missed_min_distance.scope: Priority: same scan rescued by gap-centered azimuth plus original boundary cut; 4m narrower than bin with closer control and not rescued; remaining panels/unknown. Counts describe reducer mechanism, not flight failure causes.

memory.scope: Original 5 far channels only, both current and next obs; no candidate quantiles or transient allocations.
